book.name: MATAIYO
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Mataiyo wana Leleli

content: Tau Etega Pwatum I Yohi
Lan o elana Yeisu i ulutagilem limiya i nok i na hoga bebenaa ge i misiyo.
Boda bwabwatana hot hi nogogo ge hi mipainan, inoke i gaiha waga etega elana ge i misiyo, yaa gamagalau hi talmilila datuwa.
I liwan gohalibe inoke bugul i gewi i baunan eliyalil. I ba, “Tau etega i nok eyowaa witi pwatumwina i yohi.
Sauga pwatum i yohi, enuna hi talek kamwasaa inoke bwasumu hi you tal ge hi anil.
Enuna hi talek manapatpata, ali bilibili waiwaisana nige i bwabwata. Etimwawa hi siun, kaiwena ali bilibili nige i babalu.
Yaa sauga sabwelu i ha, witi siunina i tonil yaka hi yakiwa, kaiwena ewahililiya nige i lalau bubun.
Pwatum enuna hi talek mwawin pepesala gamwaliyaa, yaka mwawin pepesala hi siun gagasisi inoke witi hi gig paaligal.
Pwatum enuna hi talek bilibili waiwaisana elana inoke hi enon, tomaha ona enoliya. Enuna enoliya wan handeled, enuna sikisti, enuna teti.
Ebo tanamiu i gan, he no baaba nuku hago.”
Hauna Puna ge Yeisu Ba Gohalibe I Liwanan
Yeisu wana tohago hi nem elana ge hi neli hi ba, “Hauna kaiwena u liwan gohalibe gamagalau elal?”
Yeisu analiya i lahe i ba, “Yehoba wana abalogugui ana nuwatu misusumena iyaka i pamasal eliyamiu, yaa nige i papamasal eliyalil.
Henala wana aatena i gan, abwe Yehoba ni paetulan, inoke Yehoba ana aatena ni bwata hot eliyana. Henala Yehoba ana aatena nige i gagan eliyana, hauna valila wana aatena kekeisi, Yehoba ni ahek yoho.
Ya liwan gohalibe eliyalil puna kaiwena hi gagayawa yaa nige hi kikite, hi lalaegan yaa nige hi hahago ge hi aatena.
He eliyalil palopita Aiseya wana leleli i tabwa tunahot i ba:

content.text: Nuku mimi lalaegan, yaa nige nuku hahago ge nuku aatena,
nuku mimi gagayawa, yaa nige nuku kikite.
Kaiwena gamagalau ya ateliya i gasisi,
Binimala nigeya, yaka nihi kite mataliyaa,
inoke nihi nuwasikal elau ge na pwamolol.

content: Yaa komiu ku waisi kaiwena matamiu i mwananal ge tanamiu i mwapwela.

Ya ba tunahot eliyamiu, palopitau ge Yehoba wana gamagalau houhouwel hi gewi nuwaliya hot hauna komiu ku kite heliya nihi kite, yaa nige hi kikite, ge nuwaliya hot hauna komiu ku hago ya panpankiti-an heliya nihi hago, yaa nige hi hahago.
Toyohi ana Ba Gohalibe Yeisu I Pwamwananal
Ku laegan ga inoke pwatum ana toyohi ana ba gohalibe ana sapu nuku hago.
Sauga ebo gamagal etega Yehoba wana abalogugui wasana ni hago, yaa ana sapu nige ni aatena, nasi Seitani ni nem ge hauna toto hi luwan atenaa ni kaluoe. He heiya te pwatum toto i talek kamwasaa.
Pwatum toto i talek manapatpata, he heiya gamagalau bolo wasa waiwaisana hi hago ge etimwawa hi ahe hi teliek ateliyaa ginebi wali yaliyaya.

Yaa bugul maisena, wasa waiwaisana nige hi nuwanuwatu-an bubun ateliyaa, ewahililiya nige i lalau bubun, inoke wali sauga nige i yayapu. Sauga ebo pulowan hi pwawa o ebo gamagalau hi palomwanagil wasa waiwaisana kaiwena, etimwawa yayaluwaliya hi pil ge hi towani.

Pwatum toto i talek mwawin pepesala gamwaliyaa, he heiya gamagalau bolo wasa waiwaisana hi hago, yaa hi nuwanuwatu panayawi yawalina kaiwena ge hi nuwa gogomwau, inoke bugul bolo ya wasa waiwaisana hi gig paaliga ge nige enona i gagan.
Pwatum toto i talek bilibili waiwaisana elana, he heiya gamagalau bolo wasa waiwaisana hi hago ge hi atena ana sapu. Hi enon, enuna enoliya wan handeled, enuna sikisti, enuna teti.”
Mwawin Nanakina ge Witi Hi Siun Toyawa
Yeisu ba gohalibe etega al i liwanan elal i ba, “Yehoba wana abalogugui i ola hiwe. Tau etega witi pwatumwina waiwaisana i yohi wana eyowaa.
Bulin etega gamagalau gegewel hi kenukenu, inoke ana topihigelgel etega i nem mwawin nanakina pwatumwina i yohi witi gamwaliyaa ge i egon.
Sauga witi i siun ge i enon telipuna, inoke mwawin nanakina i masal.
Tau o wana totuwalali hi nem elana hi ba, ‘Tonowak, witi pwatumwina waiwaisana u yohi wam eyowaa, age? Yaa mwawin nanakina ga i noem?’
Analiya i lahe i ba, ‘Topihigelgel etega i ginol te.’ Totuwalali hi nel hi ba, ‘Tab nuwam ama naha nok ge naha awaha yoho?’
Analiya i lahe i ba, ‘Bahiwa, kaiwena ebo mwawin nanakina nuku awaha yoho, nasi witi enuna alona nuku pulut toyawe.

Ali toto labui nihi siun toyawa ga, ana siga pahi ana sauga. Sauga o elana na ba topahi elal na ola: Mwawin nanakina nuku pulut houwan ge nuku kin abwe ta ton, inoke witi nuku ahe ge nuku pahe no gonu elana.’”
Masted Pwatumwina ana Ba Gohalibe
Yeisu ba gohalibe etega al i liwanan, i ba, “Yehoba wana abalogugui i ola ebwakil alana masted pwatumwina, tau etega i ahe ge i luwan wana eyowaa.

He iya pwatum gegewena wali tokekeisi, yaa sauga i siun ge i bwata, bugul gegewena bolo hi siun eyowaa i bwata lakel. I tabwa ebwakil etegana inoke bwasumu bolo hi youyou hawawala hi nem ali vata hi ginola lalana elana.”
Yis ana Ba Gohalibe

Yeisu ba gohalibe etega al i liwanan, i ba, “Yehoba wana abalogugui i ola yis, yova etega i ahe ge i telek pwalawa ana bwaya beig eton gamwanaa, inoke yis i tuwalali ana siga pwalawa gegewena i tuk solaan.”
Yeisu i liwan gohalibe inoke bugul bolo ya gegewena i baunan boda elal; ba gohalibe ya te eliyana ge bugul enuna ni liwanan elal.
Inoke palopita wana baaba i tabwa tunahot i ba:

content.text: Awau na pwela ge na ba gohalibe;
bolo hi misumi sauga toto panayawi i telipuna ana siga sauga ya.

content: Yeisu Mwawin Nanakina ana Ba Gohalibe I Sokal
Inoke Yeisu boda i tataluwagil ge i ulutuk limiya. Wana tohago hi nem elana hi ba, “Mwawin nanakina i siun eyowaa ana ba gohalibe u sokal eliyama.”
Analiya i lahe i ba, “Tau toto witi pwatumwina waiwaisana i yohi, heiya Gamagal Natuna.
Eyowa heiya panayawi, ge witi pwatumwina waiwaisana heiya Yehoba wana abalogugui gamagaliliyau. Mwawin nanakina heiya Seitani wana gamagalau,
ge topihigelgel toto mwawin nanakina pwatumwina i yohi, heiya Seitani. Pahi ana sauga heiya sauga mowamowasena, ge topahi heiya aneloseyau.
“Mwawin nanakina nihi awaha yoho ge nihi ton ginaha elana, he nasi ni ola al sauga mowamowasena elana.
Gamagal Natuna wana aneloseyau ni patunal, yaka bugul bolo gamagalau i pasogol ge hi gegi ge bolo pagan nanakina hi awaawaginol, gegewel nihi awaha yohil wana abalogugui elana.
Nihi alitukagil ginaha bwabwatana elana inoke nihi kahin ge niniliya ni alavekilal.
Inoke tosasapol nihi yana ni ola sabwelu mwananalina Tamaliya wana abalogugui elana. Ebo tanamiu i gan, inoke no baaba nuku hago.”
Gogomwau Hi Yamwi ge Bag Waiwaisana Hot ali Ba Gohalibe

Yehoba wana abalogugui i ola gogomwau bwabwatana hi yamwi eyowa etega elana ge hi yaomal luwai. Tau etega i pwawa inoke i sume pasikal. I yaliyaya bubun gogomwau o kaiwena, inoke i nok i na wana bugul gegewena i palian, manina i ahe ge eyowa i pwamola.
Yehoba wana abalogugui i ola al hiwe. Gogomwau ana topali etega bag waiwaisana i loyaagil.
Sauga etega bag waiwaisana hot molana bwabwatana i pwawa, inoke i nok i na wana bugul gegewena i palian, manina i ahe ge bag o i pwamola.
Vineya ana Ba Gohalibe
Yehoba wana abalogugui i ola al vineya hi galaan hogaa, inoke moti tomaha ge tomaha hi ona.
Sauga i kalaopop, tologi hi momol heyan gilesaa. Yaka hi misiyo ge moti hi pwaputil, bolo waiwaisal hi teli kekeha, bolo nanakil hi aliyohil.
He nasi ni ola to sauga mowamowasena elana. Aneloseyau nihi nem, tonanakil ge towaisi nihi walel, bolo nanakil nihi teli getogaagil.
Nihi alitukagil ginaha bwabwatana elana, inoke nihi kahin ge niniliya ni alavekilal.
Panpankiti Vavaluna ge Panpankiti Bebeyaunana
Yeisu wana tohago i nelil i ba, “Tab nuwamiu i sapu bugul bolo ya kaiweliya?” Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Ibwe.”

I baek elal i ba, “He logugui ana topankite gegewel, bolo iyaka hi tabwa tohago Yehoba wana abalogugui kaiwena, heliya hi ola tonlimi toto bugul vavalul ge bugul bebeyaunal i aheya wana holaviya ge i teli tagilagil.”
Nasaleta Gamagaliliyau Nige Yeisu Hi Aawatauwan
Sauga Yeisu ba gohalibe bolo ya i liwanan haba, yaka panuwa o i eguluwan
i nok i na totona wana panuwaa. I panpankiti wali limi tapwalolowa, inoke gamagalau nuwaliya hi ahe hi ba, “Wana aatena ga i aheya? Ga i ola ge i bosowaina ginol yawiyawi ni ginol?
He iya kapenta natuna age? Hinana alana Meli, talinau Yemesa, Yosepa, Saimon ge Yudasa.
Nunau gegewel iyehe avalau. He i ola, age? Inoke wana aatena ge wana siba ga i aheya?”
Inoke ateliya i elolol ge Yeisu hi pihigelgel-an. Yeisu i baek elal i ba, “Gamagalau gegewel palopita hi awatauwan, yaa tutunau ge wana panuwa gamagaliliyau ya te nige hi aawatauwan.”
Ginol yawiyawi nige i gegewi i ginola panuwa o elana kaiwena nige hi aabulilek-an.
